auth.loginPageSubtitle: Sign in to pick up where your homework left off.
auth.oauthNotConfiguredBody: Add your Google / GitHub client IDs to .env.local and restart — the buttons appear here automatically. See SETUP.md. Email sign-in below works right now.
auth.oauthNotConfiguredBold: One-tap sign-in is not configured yet.
auth.signInInvalidCredentialsError: That email and password combination doesn't match an account.
auth.signUpAutoLoginFailedNotice: Account created — sign in below to continue.
auth.signUpPageSubtitle: One tap with a provider, or an email and password.

capture.dictationFallbackNotice: Dictation records and transcribes with your AI provider, since this browser's built-in speech recognition isn't available.
capture.exampleTextEnglish: english essay on Macbeth, 1200 words, next monday
capture.exampleTextPhysics: physics numericals ch 4, questions 1 to 12, due friday and it's graded
capture.micPermissionDeniedError: Microphone permission was denied. Allow it in your browser's site settings.
capture.noDeadlineDetectedNote: No deadline detected — set one if you have it.
capture.noSpeechDetectedError: I didn't catch anything — try again a bit closer to the mic.
capture.offlineFallbackNotice: No AI model ran — this was parsed by the built-in offline fallback.
capture.offlineParserExplanation: The offline parser tidies spacing and spots common deadline phrases, but it can't fix spelling or rewrite a messy note.
capture.recordingTooShortError: That was too short to hear — hold the mic a moment longer.
capture.scholarReadsFileNote: Scholar reads {filename} and fills in the details

coach-alerts.aiNotConnectedBody: Scholar is running on its built-in offline parser, which tidies spacing and catches common deadline phrases — but it can't fix spelling or rewrite a messy note. Connecting a provider takes about a minute and there are free options.
coach-alerts.coachDefaultError: The coach couldn't answer just now.
coach-alerts.coachEmptyStateIntro: Ask about your workload and I'll answer from what's actually in Scholar — your deadlines, how much time you have, and how long your work usually takes.
coach-alerts.coachPanelSubtitle: Knows your tasks, deadlines and pace
coach-alerts.suggestionFinishByFriday: Can I finish everything before Friday?
coach-alerts.suggestionWhichFirst: Which assignment should I do first?

dashboard.attentionAllClearSummary: {count} open assignment{s}, nothing due in the next 24 hours.
dashboard.couldntDeleteTaskError: Couldn't delete that task. Try again.
dashboard.couldntSaveChangeError: Couldn't save that change. Try again.
dashboard.emptyStateNoHomework: Nothing here yet. Add your first assignment above — type it or just say it.

extension-insights.checkConnectionHint: After pasting the token into the extension, check here to confirm it actually connected.
extension-insights.estimatedVsActualSub: Total across all completed tasks, per subject
extension-insights.excludedCountClause: — {count} completed without it aren't counted in timings
extension-insights.extDescription: Highlight an assignment on any page, right-click, and send it here. Paste this token into the extension once to connect it.
extension-insights.extensionPageSubtitle: Send assignments straight from any page on the web.
extension-insights.footnoteAccuracyNote: . Durations are what was measured; accuracy figures are estimates and get more reliable with more sessions.
extension-insights.insightsPageSubtitle: How your work actually goes — pace, estimates, and patterns.
extension-insights.installStepLoadUnpacked: Click "Load unpacked" and pick that folder.
extension-insights.installStepOpenExtensions: Open chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode.
extension-insights.installStepPasteToken: Click the Scholar icon, paste the token above, and you're set.
extension-insights.installStepUnzip: Unzip the extension folder somewhere you'll keep it.
extension-insights.noHistoryDescription: Finish a few tasks using the focus timer and this fills in — how long your work actually takes, which subjects run over, and whether you're finishing on time.
extension-insights.timedOnlyFootnote: Built only from tasks completed with the focus timer
extension-insights.tokenPasswordWarning: Treat it like a password — anyone with it can add homework to your account.

groups.panelDescription: A shared board for group projects and revision. Your own homework stays private — only what you post here is visible to the group.
groups.reportButtonTitle: Report as wrong, misleading, or something else

homework.noAssessmentsToScheduleMessage: No dated assessments in the future, so there's nothing to schedule yet.
homework.nothingSavedNote: Nothing is saved until you add it.
homework.subjectsEmptyState: Subjects appear here automatically as the AI categorises your work.
homework.timeRecordedNote: Time is recorded when you finish, and used to make future estimates for {subject} more accurate.
homework.upNextEmptyState: Nothing with a deadline yet. Add one and it'll show up here.
homework.workingNotesPlaceholder: Questions attempted, where you got stuck, what's left…

lms-calendar.calendarPageDescription: Export or sync your deadlines and classes to an external calendar.
lms-calendar.feedModeDescription: Scholar reads your LMS's calendar feed — the same link you'd use to put coursework in Google Calendar. No account linking, and it only ever reads.
lms-calendar.icsFeatureDescription: Download your deadlines and classes, then import into Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar.
lms-calendar.importPageDescription: Bring in assignments from your school's LMS or a pasted notice.
lms-calendar.notConfiguredDescription: This deployment hasn't set up Google sign-in credentials yet — Google Calendar sync reuses them. See SETUP.md.
lms-calendar.nothingSavesUntilAddedNote: Nothing saves until you add it.
lms-calendar.noticeModeDescription: For school ERPs that don't offer a calendar feed (Shikshak, Entab, Fedena, Teachmint and similar), paste the homework notice or diary email instead — Scholar reads it the same way.
lms-calendar.noticeTextareaPlaceholder:
Paste the homework notice or diary email as it was sent — school ERP apps
like Shikshak, Entab, Fedena, Teachmint and similar don't offer a calendar
feed, but they almost always email or post a homework notice you can copy.
For example:

Maths: Workbook pg 42, Q1-10. Submit tomorrow.
Science: Read Chapter 3, notes in copy.
English: Essay on "My favourite season" due Friday.
lms-calendar.outlookTwoWaySyncNote: Two-way sync needs a registered Microsoft application.
lms-calendar.platformInstructionsBlackboard: Open Calendar → "Get External Calendar Link" → copy the URL.
lms-calendar.platformInstructionsCanvas: Open Calendar → "Calendar Feed" in the right sidebar → copy the link.
lms-calendar.platformInstructionsClassroom: Classroom feeds into Google Calendar. In Calendar settings, open your Classroom calendar → "Secret address in iCal format".
lms-calendar.platformInstructionsMoodle: Open Calendar → "Export calendar" → All events → "Get calendar URL".
lms-calendar.platformInstructionsTeams: Outlook → Calendar → Share → Publish a calendar → "Can view all details" → copy the ICS link.
lms-calendar.redirectUriMismatchHelp: Getting "redirect_uri_mismatch"? Add this exact URL as an Authorised redirect URI on the same Google OAuth client used for sign-in, in the Google Cloud Console:
lms-calendar.twoWaySyncDescription: Two-way sync: assignments appear on your calendar, and edits to those events sync back.

settings-ai.apiKeyPlaceholderSaved: Saved ({keyHint}) — type a new key to replace it
settings-ai.canStillTypeModelHint: You can still type a model name above and press Enter.
settings-ai.chooseProviderSubtext: Your key is encrypted before it's stored and is never sent to the browser again — only a masked hint comes back.
settings-ai.envFallbackNotice: Nothing saved here yet, so Scholar is using the configuration in your .env.local file. Anything you set below takes priority over it, per account.
settings-ai.heuristicNoKeyNotice: No API key needed. This is the built-in fallback — it works offline but won't rewrite messy notes well.
settings-ai.hitDetectModelsHint: Hit "Detect models" to load the live list, or type a name and press Enter.
settings-ai.keyPrefixHint: Most {providerLabel} keys start with {prefixList}. If yours doesn't, it may still be fine — hit Test connection to find out.
settings-ai.navHintPreferences: What Scholar warns you about, and in which language
settings-ai.navHintSharing: What a parent or guardian can see
settings-ai.ollamaNoKeyNotice: No API key needed — this runs on your own machine. Install it from {keyUrlLabel}, then run ollama pull {defaultModel}.
settings-ai.pageSubtitle: Choose which AI reads your homework, how much time you have to study, and how Scholar looks and talks to you.
settings-ai.removeKeySuccessMessage: API key deleted. Parsing falls back to the offline parser until you add another.
settings-ai.saveSuccessMessage: Saved. New homework will be parsed with this provider.
settings-ai.testNoResponseError: The test didn't come back. Check the terminal running the app.
settings-ai.typeModelNameHint: Type a model name and press Enter.

settings-rest.accountInfoBulletText: your name and email address, either entered directly or provided by the sign-in method you choose (Google or GitHub). We only ever request basic profile info and an email address — never posts, friends lists, or other social data.
settings-rest.alertsDescription: Scholar only raises these when the numbers actually warrant it — there are no recurring reminders and nothing fires on a timer.
settings-rest.appearanceDescription: Pick any accent color — it reskins buttons, gradients, focus rings and the ambient background everywhere in Scholar, and follows your account to any device you sign into.
settings-rest.changesToPolicyParagraph: If this policy changes meaningfully, we'll update the date at the top of this page. Continued use of Scholar after a change means you accept the updated policy.
settings-rest.chronicUnderestimationSignalHint: A subject consistently takes longer than planned
settings-rest.codeWorksOnceNote: Works once. After they use it, the code stops working.
settings-rest.confirmResetMemoryMessage: Delete everything Scholar has learned? Estimates go back to raw values.
settings-rest.contactParagraph: Questions about privacy or data handling? Email {email}.
settings-rest.customColorHint: Any hue — drag to preview, it saves automatically.
settings-rest.dataNeverLeavesDeviceNote: This data never leaves your device.
settings-rest.dataStorageSecurityParagraph: Your data is stored in a managed Postgres database and encrypted in transit (HTTPS) everywhere. Sensitive tokens (like calendar sync credentials) are additionally encrypted at rest. Only you can see your own homework data through your authenticated account.
settings-rest.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently removes your homework, history, groups you own, and every share you've created. This cannot be undone and there is no backup.
settings-rest.deleteIndividualTasksBulletText: any time from your dashboard — this removes them immediately and permanently.
settings-rest.deleteWholeAccountBulletText: by emailing {email} from the address on your account, with the subject "Delete my Scholar account". We'll permanently delete your account, homework data, and any stored sign-in or calendar-sync tokens within 30 days, and confirm by email once it's done.
settings-rest.deletingYourDataIntro: You're always in control of your data. To delete it:
settings-rest.disconnectCalendarBulletText: from Settings → Calendar, which also revokes Scholar's access token with Google.
settings-rest.examApproachingSignalHint: An exam is close and nothing is scheduled for it
settings-rest.exportEverythingDescription: All your homework, history, subjects and settings as a JSON file. Encrypted API keys and attachment contents are left out on purpose.
settings-rest.homeworkDataBulletText: the tasks, deadlines, subjects, and notes you add — typed, spoken, imported from a Canvas/LMS calendar feed, or synced from Google Calendar if you connect it.
settings-rest.howWeUseItParagraph: Solely to run Scholar for you: showing your tasks, sending reminders, generating AI summaries of your own workload, and — if you turn it on — keeping your tasks in sync with Google Calendar. We do not sell your data, share it with advertisers, or use it to train third-party AI models beyond the request needed to answer your own question inside the app.
settings-rest.languageDescription: These are separate on purpose. You can read an English interface, type in a mix of languages, and still get answers back in whichever you prefer.
settings-rest.mixedInputExampleNote: Mixed input works without changing anything — "physics ka ch 4 friday ko submit karna hai" is read as a Physics assignment due Friday.
settings-rest.notEnoughTimeSignalHint: A task needs more time than remains before its deadline
settings-rest.nothingDueTwoWeeksMessage: Nothing due in the next two weeks.
settings-rest.nothingLearnedYetMessage: Nothing learned yet. Finish a task with the focus timer and it'll start calibrating your estimates.
settings-rest.notificationsDefaultDescription: Allow notifications to see alerts outside the tab.
settings-rest.notificationsDeniedDescription: Blocked in your browser's site settings.
settings-rest.notificationsGrantedDescription: Alerts appear as system notifications while Scholar is running.
settings-rest.notificationsOnToastBody: Scholar will tell you when work is at risk.
settings-rest.overduePileupSignalHint: Three or more tasks are past their deadline
settings-rest.overloadedDaysSignalHint: Several deadlines land on the same day
settings-rest.privacyIntroParagraph: Varaxis Scholar ("Scholar", "we", "us") is a homework organiser built by Varaxis. This page explains what information we collect, why, and how you can control or delete it. It applies to the Scholar web app at scholar-varaxis.vercel.app and to sign-in via Google or GitHub.
settings-rest.privacyPolicyMetaDescription: How Varaxis Scholar collects, uses, and lets you delete your data.
settings-rest.repeatedLatenessSignalHint: A recent pattern of missing deadlines
settings-rest.shareNoLongerAvailableError: That share is no longer available.
settings-rest.shareWithParentDescription: You choose exactly what they can see, and you can stop it at any time. They never get access to your account — only to the summary you pick.
settings-rest.shareWithParentHeading: Share with a parent or guardian
settings-rest.sharedWithYouDescription: Summaries other people have chosen to share. They can stop at any time.
settings-rest.signInMethodsDescription: What you can use to get into this account. Signing in linked more than one automatically when the same email address matched.
settings-rest.signInToLinkHint: Sign out, then sign in with {provider} using this email to link it
settings-rest.studyHoursExplanation: Work isn't scheduled outside this window, so a deadline at 9am tomorrow counts tonight's hours — not the hours you'd be asleep.
settings-rest.studyTimeDescription: Scholar uses this to judge whether you actually have time for a task before it's due — not just how close the deadline is.
settings-rest.summaryOnlyDisclaimer: This is a summary only. Task details, notes, attachments and coach conversations are never shared, and {subjectName} can stop sharing at any time.
settings-rest.testNotificationBody: This is what an alert looks like.
settings-rest.thirdPartySignInParagraph: When you sign in with Google or GitHub, that provider shares only your name, email address, and profile picture with us — enough to create your Scholar account. We never receive your password for that provider, and we never post on your behalf. You can review or remove connected sign-in methods any time from Settings → Account.
settings-rest.usageDataBulletText: basic technical logs (timestamps, error reports) used only to keep the app working and to debug issues.
settings-rest.varaxisIdDescription: One account for Varaxis products. Scholar is the first — others will sign in with this same identity rather than asking you to start again.
settings-rest.whatScholarLearnedDescription: Built only from tasks you finished using the focus timer. Estimates are adjusted toward how long your work actually takes.
settings-rest.yourDataDescription: Everything Scholar holds lives in a database file on this machine. Nothing is sent anywhere except the AI provider you configured, and only when you ask it to read something.

timetable.addWithFormBelowHint: Add those with the form below.
timetable.emptyHintDefault: No classes yet — import a timetable above.
timetable.imageTooLargeError: That image is over 6MB — try a smaller photo or screenshot.
timetable.importSectionSubtitle: Paste it or attach a photo — Scholar reads it and you confirm before anything saves.
timetable.noClassesFoundMessage: No classes could be read from that. Try pasting it as plain text, or add them individually below.
timetable.pageSubtitle: Your recurring classes, so Scholar knows when you're free to study.
timetable.panelSubtitle: Recurring classes, so the coach knows when you're in lessons rather than free to study.
timetable.pastePlaceholder:
Paste your timetable however it comes — a grid copied from a PDF, a list, whatever your school gives you. For example:

Mon  P1 08:40 Maths R12   P2 09:40 Physics Lab2
Tue  P1 08:40 English R4  P2 09:40 Chemistry R9
...
timetable.setupTabDescription: Import or fix your timetable here any time — the same list is used everywhere in Scholar, including Settings → Preferences. Breaks and library periods can be imported too — tag them from the timetable text or fix the tag afterwards below.
